propositions: Existing guidance in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly licenses retrying flaky tests until they pass, contradicting the directive that flaky tests must be debugged to root cause.

A single authoritative rule must be established in AGENTS.md stating that intermittent test failures are bugs to root-cause via /rebar-debug, not retry opportunities, with environmental faults as the only legitimate recheck carve-out.

CONTRIBUTING.md section 6 must be rewritten to split transient/flaky failures into two cases: environmental faults (recheckable with stated reasoning) and nondeterministic tests (bugs requiring debugging), with cross-reference to the AGENTS.md rule.
A new test file tests/unit/test_flaky_test_guidance.py must verify both the presence of the new rule's load-bearing phrases and the absence of the old retry-until-green licence in both documents.
